method: Every contact-sheet page viewed in timeline order; 2 fps samples across each complete artifact. The 1655 pilot also reviewed at 4 fps. This is sampled screening, not inspection of every raw frame.
scope: Visual-only, one application. No media redistribution or training permission asserted. Internal implementation requirements are grounded in the accompanying issue text and oracle, not inferred from pixels alone.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1557.text: Morphing a data store outside a pool to a data object produces an error. The replacement menu should prevent an invalid reference outside the pool.
bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1557.oracle_alignment_reason: The test opens the replacement menu on a data store outside a participant and asserts there is no data-object reference choice, one of the source issue's explicit acceptable outcomes.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1567.text: After wrapping a process in a pool and entering a subprocess, clicking the parent breadcrumb fails to return to the root. Navigation should follow the changed root.
bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1567.oracle_alignment_reason: The test clicks the root breadcrumb after a root change, directly exercising the failed navigation shown.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1570.text: Wrapping the process in a pool makes the diagram jump in the viewport. The current scroll and zoom should be preserved, including undo and redo.
bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1570.oracle_alignment_reason: The tests compare viewport position and zoom before/after collaboration creation, undo/redo and navigating back.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1578.text: After copying a pool containing a task, exporting and importing the diagram produces errors. Copying must create distinct process identities and correctly connected diagram information.
bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1578.oracle_alignment_reason: The supplied failing test checks diagram-information object identity after copying a subprocess; it does not reproduce copying pools or assert distinct process IDs after export/import. Retain its passing native oracle as supporting evidence, but exclude it from the direct-claim M0 gate.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1610.text: An active text editing box remains visible after leaving the subprocess plane. Changing the root should finish editing the previous element.
bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1610.oracle_alignment_reason: The test changes root while editing, then asserts editing ended and the edited name was submitted.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1623.text: After switching diagrams and returning, the subprocess drilldown overlay disappears. Subprocess navigation should remain available after reopening the diagram.
bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1623.oracle_alignment_reason: The test reopens the diagram and asserts the drilldown overlay and breadcrumb navigation remain functional.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1638.text: Clearing a task label triggers linting errors. Clearing the name should remove its label information rather than leave a null label property.
bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1638.oracle_alignment_reason: The test clears the task name and asserts the diagram-information label property is absent, the explicit source issue requirement.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1655.text: After setting an external label to orange, its text uses the pale fill color rather than the darker stroke color. External label text should use the stroke color.
bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1655.oracle_alignment_reason: The test applies distinct stroke/fill colors to an external label and asserts its text uses the stroke color.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1659.text: Resizing an expanded subprocess reroutes its sequence flow while the label and attached association remain behind. Labels and associations should follow the updated connection.
bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1659.oracle_alignment_reason: The tests update connection waypoints and assert label coordinates and incoming/outgoing association endpoints follow the new route.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1677.text: Removing an element with direct editing active leaves an editing box behind and breaks the interaction. Removing the selected element should cancel direct editing.
bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1677.oracle_alignment_reason: The test removes a selected element during editing and asserts the pending edited name was not applied.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1679.text: Switching a task from loop to parallel or sequential changes its marker but leaves the exported XML loop type unchanged. The selected loop characteristics must be serialized correctly.
bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1679.oracle_alignment_reason: The tests toggle parallel/sequential from a standard loop and assert the resulting business-object loop type and sequential flag.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1719.text: Collapsing an expanded subprocess leaves internal event labels visible outside it. Labels belonging to the subprocess should move to its hidden plane.
bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1719.oracle_alignment_reason: The test collapses an expanded subprocess after moving its event label and asserts the label belongs to the hidden subprocess plane.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1640.text: Changing a subprocess from parallel to sequential multi-instance clears its loop cardinality and other properties. Changing the multi-instance mode should preserve the existing properties except the sequential flag.
bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1640.oracle_alignment_reason: The tests toggle parallel/sequential and assert equality of loop characteristics excluding only the sequential flag.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1928.text: Using the space tool vertically across an empty pool increases its height. An empty pool should retain its fixed height during vertical space-tool movement.
bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1928.oracle_alignment_reason: The test applies vertical space-tool movement to an empty participant and compares all bounds to the original bounds.
